messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty - Incident PD-8721 fired for service 'runtime-latency-us-east1' (severity: page). Trigger: metric(runtime.p99) > 500ms for 2m. Affected: us-east-1, pool=gpu-prod. Link: https://pd.example/PD-8721
incident-bot: Incident created: PD-8721. Runbook: /runbooks/runtime-high-p99. Paging on-call: @alex. Escalation in 5m if unack'd.
alex: acked. I'll start looking. seeing a couple noise spikes on the dashboard.
maya: on standby if you need extra pair. do we know customer impact? any 500s?
alex: quick check: infra 2xx rate steady, no 5xx flood. only token-level latency. no user-visible errors reported in our support queue.
jordan: got Cloudwatch alert stream here — short burst of p99 in region. looks like a matcher: a few requests with seqlen=10k causing huge decode times.
ops-bot: Auto-resolution policy: If p99 drops below threshold for 3m and PD incident open <10m, auto-resolve. Monitoring for autoresolve.
alex: running prometheus query for the window now:
```
max_over_time(runtime_p99_ms{region="us-east-1"}[3m])
```
alex: results: spike to ~820ms at 1962104280, then back to ~120ms by 1962104340.
maya: can you grep logs for long sequence inputs? I suspect a few noisy requests (user debugging payloads).
alex: grabbing tails from runtime logs:
```
2026-05-15T21:12:58Z INFO request_id=abc123 seq_len=10123 model=rwkv-13b decode_ms=650
2026-05-15T21:12:59Z INFO request_id=def456 seq_len=9800 model=rwkv-13b decode_ms=720
```
alex: looks like two large seqlen requests on the same node within 10s. node CPU saturation on that worker briefly.
jordan: any autoscaling or preemption events?
ops-bot: No preemptions recorded. GPU mem stable. small CPU steal on those hosts.
maya: if it's isolated noisy requests, low customer impact. recommend throttling long seqlen at edge or temporary qps cap.
alex: tried a lightweight mitigation: enabled per-route max_seq_len=8192 and lowered continuous batch size on that pool for 10m.
incident-bot: Action logged: config change applied by alex. Config: `max_seq_len=8192`, `batch_target=32` on pool gpu-prod-us-east.
alex: p99 dropped back under 200ms across pool. PD should auto-resolve in a bit.
jordan: verified no customer errors on support. Affected traces are internal dev/test clients.
ops-bot: PD auto-resolve check: current p99=148ms for last 2m -> passing threshold. Auto-resolve triggered.
pagerduty-bot: PD-8721 auto-resolved at 1962104418. Reason: metric returned below threshold.
maya: thanks alex — can you add a short note to the runbook about noisy long-sequence traffic pattern and recommend rate-limiting?
alex: will do. Creating follow-up ticket: INF-4593 (runbook update + enforce long-seq throttles).
incident-bot: Follow-up task INF-4593 created and assigned to @alex, due 2026-05-18.
maya: handoff: I'm oncall for the next shift, will take secondary on INF-4593. ping me if it reoccurs. :thumbsup:
alex: noted. marking thread resolved. leaving logs/snippets in ticket.
jordan: small postmortem not required; noise alert. recommend lowering alert sensitivity for this metric or switch to sustained-window policy.
ops-bot: Suggestion recorded: change runtime.p99 alert to require >500ms for 5m (currently 2m). filing config change request INF-4594.
alex: thanks team. closing thread.
